plan.title: Single-Stage RFQ Required and Optional Terms Acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ and award the lot to one vendor.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet, including the delivery-location field.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days as None, click Done, and stop with the configured terms visible or otherwise proven saved.

steps.note: Configure the named event-wise terms because no dedicated catalog step can add or classify clauses.
Invite one available QA vendor for Vendor A's bid.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round as the vendor.
Verify that the required clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify that the optional clause is also visible to the vendor.
Accept the delivery clause as required by the scenario.
Quote 100 for the line and submit after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
